title: Autonomous search for stable imidazole–salicylic-acid hydrogen-bonded complexes
difficulty_reasons: The agent must generate and prioritize a broad intermolecular orientation and donor/acceptor hypothesis space.
Each candidate requires independent optimization, stationary-point validation, deduplication, and coverage/stopping justification.

paper.title: Efficient and air-stable perovskite solar cells driven by interfacial self-assembly and hydrogen bond system: Dual interface passivation and collaborative mechanism

data.description: Explicit 6-atom neutral imidazole starting geometry, including its N1-H and three ring C-H protons; connectivity is defined in system.json.
Explicit 16-atom neutral 2-hydroxybenzoic-acid starting geometry, including four aromatic C-H and both O-H protons; connectivity is defined in system.json.
Explicit stoichiometry, connectivity, proton placement, charge, multiplicity, environment, interaction-energy definition, and identity constraints.

required_deliverables.description: Structured candidate-level investigation, validation, energies, coverage/stopping record, and final conclusion.
